subject: Sunridge Bank — control crosslink and artifact pickup for CAIQ mapping
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@sunridgebank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sunridge Bank — control crosslink and artifact pickup for CAIQ mapping

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for taking time yesterday. As discussed, were preparing a focused CAIQ crosslink that maps Sunridges requested CSA controls to our runtime and operational artifacts. To keep this lightweight for your audit window, we propose a short artifact pickup: a curated set of logs, attestations, and brief owner comments rather than the full runbook dump.

What we need from your side to start:
- A short list of priority control IDs youd like us to annotate (top 20, or those affecting tenant isolation, key management, telemetry).
- Access to a secure upload destination (SFTP or a Drive folder with restricted ACLs).
- Any required formatting for evidence (PDF snapshots, CSV log extracts, or short screen-recorded walkthroughs).

Attached: sunridge_caiq_request.pdf (outline + example mapping) and a starter crosslink template (well fill and hand back).

Proposed timeline: we can deliver an initial annotated crosswalk + sampled artifacts within 5 business days after we get your priority list and upload location. If you prefer, we can run a joint 30-minute control-walk tomorrow to triage owners.

Ill loop Kim (control owner for runtime telemetry) and Marissa (engagement lead) on sequencing.

Next steps (small asks):
1) Reply with the preferred upload method (Drive link or SFTP)
2) Share top 20 control IDs (or say "All")
3) If needed, pick a slot for the 30-minute walk: tomorrow 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00 PT

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: sunridge_caiq_request.pdf (18KB)
From: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@sunridgebank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sunridge Bank Security Team <security@sunridgebank.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sunridge Bank — control crosslink and artifact pickup for CAIQ mapping

Neha,

Thanks — that approach sounds good and pragmatic. Well start with a focused set: controls related to tenant isolation, key lifecycle (KMS/HSM), logging/telemetry for inference endpoints, and delivery integrity. Ive listed the IDs below (excerpt from our CAIQ scope):
- CCM-IS-01 (Tenant segregation)
- CCM-CR-05 (Key management lifecycle)
- CCM-AL-03 (API access logging)
- CCM-OT-02 (Operational change control for runtime)

Upload: we can provision a restricted Drive folder; Ill have our security ops create it and share with the redwood-artifacts service account by EOD. If you need SFTP instead, flag it — Drive is easier for our reviewers.

Formatting: PDF snapshots for configuration, CSV extracts for sampled logs (max 72 hours), and a short owner note (1–2 paragraphs) that explains the artifacts scope.

Wed appreciate if you can call out where inference-specific telemetry maps to the control (e.g., KV cache access tracing, kernel selection logs, edge routing fallbacks) — helps the reviewers who havent seen Redwoods runtime before.

Ill send the Drive invite to neha_kapoor@redwood.ai and to a service account you provide.

Jordan Patel
Senior InfoSec Manager — Third-Party Assurance
Sunridge Bank
jordan.patel@sunridgebank.com

Attachment: Sunridge_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (45KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sunridge Bank — control crosslink and artifact pickup for CAIQ mapping

Neha — adding our internal commitments and owners so were aligned for the pickup: 

Owners: 
- Tenant segregation / isolation: Logan Wright (cc'd in the attachment mapping)
- Key management / KMS proofs: Priya Natarajan
- Telemetry & runtime logs: Kimberly Park (me) — I will produce a sampled KV cache trace, API gateway access logs (filtered), and a short narrative mapping each snippet to the CAIQ claim.

Deliverables we will upload to your Drive folder when you share the link: 
1) rwd_control_crosslink_template.xlsx (filled for the four controls Jordan listed)
2) runtime-telemetry-sample-2026-09.csv (72-hour sample, redacted)
3) kms-rotation-snapshot.pdf (KMS console snapshot + rotation policy)
4) owner-notes.pdf (1-page per artifact)

Timing: assuming drive access arrives EOD on 2026-09-30, well prepare and upload the items by 2026-10-05 COB. If they need an interim quick hit, we can push the crosslink spreadsheet by 2026-10-02.

Minor ask: for the telemetry sample Ill need the list of approved fields Sunridge needs redacted (IP address, user ids, tenant ids). Please confirm defaults: redact tenant ids, keep aggregated latency metrics.

Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: rwd_control_crosslink_template.xlsx (12KB)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@sunridgebank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sunridge Bank — control crosslink and artifact pickup for CAIQ mapping

Jordan — thanks for the fast turnaround and the control set. Drive is perfect. Please share the folder link when its ready and add neha_kapoor@redwood.ai and redwood-artifacts@redwood.ai.

Summary/timeline:
- Today: Sunridge provisions Drive folder and shares link + ACLs
- 2026-10-02: RWD will upload initial crosslink spreadsheet (partial) and the owner-notes PDF
- 2026-10-05 COB: Full artifact bundle (telemetry sample, KMS snapshot, CSVs)
- 2026-10-06: 30-minute review walkthrough (optional) to handoff context to your reviewers

Privacy/redaction defaults we will apply unless you instruct otherwise: redact tenant ids and user PII fields, keep aggregated latency and error-rate metrics, preserve timestamps at second-level granularity. If you want hashed tenant ids instead of redaction, let us know.

Deliverable pointers we will include in the Drive folder: a short README (artifact_upload_instructions.md), the populated rwd_control_crosslink_template.xlsx, and each artifact with a 1-paragraph owner note.

If all good, Jordan — please share the Drive link and we will start the upload.

Appreciate the partnership on this.
Neha
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Drive link (placeholder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-redwood-sunridge-artifacts
